shell.dataSavedLocally: Data is saved on this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fxDesc: Configure base currency and FX rate sources.
settings.baseCurrencyDesc: All account balances will be converted to this currency.
settings.generalDesc: Configure display, language, timezone, and backups.
settings.privacyModeDesc: Hides all monetary amounts. Can be toggled with ⌘⇧H.
settings.languageDesc: Affects app UI and asset names.
settings.backupDesc: Export your entire database to a JSON file. Importing will overwrite all current data.
settings.dataExportDesc: Select format, range, and accounts to export data.

onboarding.panelDesc: Northstar never connects to your bank automatically. Import a CSV, add accounts manually, or explore with demo data. Everything stays on your device.
onboarding.privacyNote: Your data stays on this device by default; sync and the logo CDN are opt-in.

step0.title: Where do you want to start?
step0.description: Adding an account gives net worth and cash flow a foundation; if you already have a CSV, jump straight to the import preview.
step0.manualDesc: Bank, cash, credit card, and brokerage accounts are all supported.
step0.ledgerDesc: Bulk import using date, account, amount, currency columns.
step0.investDesc: The Investments page supports column mapping and preview.
step0.demoDesc: Won't touch your real data — you can exit demo mode anytime.

step1.title: Add your accounts
step1.description: Account names don't have to match the bank exactly; logos are auto-detected, and you can pick a bank or broker manually when editing an account.
step1.fieldsMapped: Fields mapped — review invalid rows before importing

step2.title: Import a ledger CSV
step2.description: Bulk import for everyday transactions. The CSV needs date, account, amount, currency; account matches an existing account name or id.
step2.chooseFileHasAccounts: Generates a preview first — nothing is written directly.
step2.chooseFileNoAccounts: Add an account first, otherwise the account column can't be matched.

step3.title: Your workspace is ready
step3.description: Next, record transactions, review investments, or open Settings to turn on bank logos and sync.
step3.ledgerDesc: Quickly add income, expenses, transfers, or receivables/payables.
step3.investDesc: Add holdings, import a broker CSV, set up recurring buys.
step3.privacyDesc: Turn on logos, sync, backups, and FX settings.

investmentsAnalytics.regionNote: Estimated from each holding's listing market; ETFs/funds counted at their own listing.
